final_message:
Blog slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters, so "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes all 3 tests, including `test/blog-slug.test.js`.

The vendored `slugify` drops every non-ASCII character, and `vendor/` is off-limits. So I fixed it in `src/blog/slug.js` instead. `postSlug` now strips accents from the title before calling `slugify`. I didn't touch `vendor/`.

Shop product URLs (`src/shop/product-url.js`) call the same vendored function, so they still drop accented letters. I left them alone because you only asked about blog posts. The same stripping step would fix them if you want it.
